reasons: Preserves the approved teal/silver appearance and the 512 px brushed grain.
Cuts download bytes from 6,281,824 to 4,091,852 (-34.9%) and decoded texture storage from 25,165,824 to 15,728,640 (-37.5%) versus v3.
Keeps one UV set and one TEXCOORD layout; no extra UV map or per-primitive unused UV attributes.
Best-centered silver density of the tested candidates: front p05/median/p95 0.502 / 1.039 / 2.407; three-quarter 0.446 / 0.870 / 2.138.
density_limitation: Silver trim p95 remains above the advisory 2.0 ceiling and p05 below 1.0. This is recorded as a reviewed limitation, not a clean density pass.

alternates.reason: Visibly softer bevel grain at 1.3 m; only ~16% smaller than v4.
Clears p95 with 512 detail via UVMap_Silver at 0.8, but lowers the median below 1.0, adds TEXCOORD_1 and two validator infos.

future_asset_delivery_rule: Choose delivery resolution per material using the closest intended gameplay views.
Prefer the simplest UV/material setup that preserves the accepted appearance.
Validate base colour, normal, roughness, metallic, seams, tiling and mip behaviour after downsampling.
Treat texel-density ranges as guidance, not a score to optimize against visual quality.
